history_audit.ttt_trials: fixed exhaustive oracle folds, not new trials

solo.note: Paired games or held-out puzzles per mode. Fixed node budgets; no time comparison. 2048 has a 2000-move cap; truncations never count as wins.

league.note: Paired starts and seats. Random, center, edges, tactical, frozen 1.0, 2.0 and specified frozen champion. No defeats excluded. Legacy 1.0 has 5000 nodes; tactical has no tree search; other search agents have equal fixed nodes. Held-out failures stay quarantined.

notes: Only training examples enter replay. Old validation and test cases remain excluded, including canonical mirrors; new non-TTT trials also exclude old encoded policy data and position-head data.
The finite TTT test fold is repeated, not new.
Position accuracy measures raw policy decisions; it does not establish whole-game invincibility.
All paired full-game results include losses and truncations. Small samples are not proof of statistical superiority.
